sentences.en: When someone is symptomatic, that person has visible signs of being sick.
sentences.zh: 当某人出现症状时，那个人有生病的明显迹象。

sentences.en: Not everyone with the virus is symptomatic.
sentences.zh: 并非所有感染病毒的人都会出现症状。

sentences.en: Her cough and fever are symptomatic of her flu.
sentences.zh: 她的咳嗽和发烧是流感的症状。

senses.zh: 征兆的，症候的；有症状的 - 根据症状的 -
